content.text: Without an index, MongoDB scans every document (COLLSCAN). An index lets MongoDB jump directly to matching documents (IXSCAN).
Create indexes for fields you filter, sort, or join on. Too many indexes slow writes.

questions.question: What is a COLLSCAN?
options: A collection scan — reads every document
questions.explanation: COLLSCAN means MongoDB scanned the whole collection because no suitable index existed.

faq.q: How many indexes should a collection have?
faq.a: Create only the indexes your queries actually need. Each index costs write performance and storage. Use explain() to verify index usage.
